subject.title: feat(android): add safe cron job management

question: After the source blockers and merge conflict are resolved, should maintainers require inspectable Android runtime proof for this cron-management feature or accept the PR body's Testbox/build summaries as a proof override?
rationale: The branch adds admin-scoped mobile controls for scheduled Gateway work, and the external-PR real-behavior proof gate is not satisfied by summary-only test and CI evidence unless a maintainer intentionally overrides it.

options.title: Require Inspectable Android Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted emulator or device recording, screenshots with logs, linked artifact, terminal/live output, or redacted runtime logs showing run, edit, enable/disable, history, and delete behavior on the reviewed head.

options.title: Accept Proof Override
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the existing Testbox/build summaries and own the remaining runtime-proof uncertainty after code blockers are fixed.

options.title: Pause Until Live Validation Lands
options.body: Keep this PR open without landing until the in-progress API 36 validation is attached in an inspectable form.

recommendation.title: Require Inspectable Android Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted emulator or device recording, screenshots with logs, linked artifact, terminal/live output, or redacted runtime logs showing run, edit, enable/disable, history, and delete behavior on the reviewed head.
